markets.rules_primary:
If the Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index for the week ending October 23, 2026 is above 

-0.62, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index (“NFCI”) refers to the headline NFCI published by the Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago. It does not refer to the Adjusted National Financial Conditions Index (“ANFCI”) or any individual component or contribution to the NFCI.

This market will resolve using the NFCI value for the week ending October 23, 2026 published in the first Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago update that reports that week. Subsequent revisions will not affect settlement.
